title: Minecraft Zombie
blurb: The Minecraft zombie groan is a deceptively clever piece of sound design: a human voice, pitched down and stretched until it stops being human but keeps just enough of the original to unsettle you. Players learn to read it by volume and direction long before they can see anything, which is why hearing it underground at night is genuinely alarming rather than merely informative. C418's audio work on the 2011 release is a large part of why the game still feels like itself. Two seconds of this turns any Discord call into a cave.
origin: The zombie idle groan from Minecraft.
